description: Basic single-turn research query with synthetic memory data
notes: This task exercises the vector path, which since ADR 0009 is the only retrieval path a run has. Its neo4j seed entries are :Concept nodes that no request reads; before ADR 0009 the graph retriever returned nothing from them either, because they carry no :Fact. trajectory_precision over the node sequence is reported rather than gated because act loops up to maxSteps and every extra iteration lowers it; the tool metrics are reported rather than gated because whether the model reaches for a tool is a property of the model, and the stub set never does.
